name: capell-app/widget-showcase
description: Ten page widgets in one install, covering images, audio, video, charts, maps, polls, countdowns and pop-up cards.

marketplace.summary: One bundle that brings in ten page widgets, from a before and after slider to a countdown, chart, map and poll.
marketplace.description: A bundle of ten widgets for pages built in Layout Builder. It includes a before and after slider, numbered image points, a slideshow, an audio playlist, a YouTube video, a countdown, a chart, a location map, a live poll and pop-up cards. You choose which to place on a page.
marketplace.problem: I want a full set of page widgets without finding and installing each package one by one.
marketplace.outcome: Ten page widgets arrive in one install and appear in the widget list.

faq.question: What do I get when I install the bundle?
faq.answer: Ten page widgets, so editors can try them before deciding which to use. The bundle has nothing to configure, and each widget has its own settings.

faq.question: Which widgets are included?
faq.answer: Before and after, hotspots, slideshow, audio playlist, YouTube, countdown, data chart, location map, live poll and content reveal.

faq.question: What do the widgets need?
faq.answer: Every widget needs Layout Builder, the page builder, so editors can add it to a page.

faq.question: Can I install only some of the widgets?
faq.answer: Yes. Each widget is a package of its own, so you can install just the ones you want instead of the bundle.

faq.question: What happens if one widget fails to install?
faq.answer: The other widgets added during that run are marked as not installed again.
